description.value: A shaded, family-oriented forest campground near Sorrento with a short walk to White Lake; flush washrooms and free showers on site make it a comfortable stop. Tent sites run $50/night, it skews RV-heavy, and the season is May through September only.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms this is an active seasonal campground (May–September) on White Lake near Sorrento, BC, with both RV and tent sites. Showers are explicitly confirmed ('free showers are also available' on front page, corroborated by guest review). Reservations are confirmed via a dedicated reservation request form. The contact page mentions 'biking' as an activity. No evidence of hiker/biker-specific sites, laundry, food service, or cyclist-specific amenities. Phone (250 835 4600), address (4010 Settle Road, Sorrento, BC V0E 2W0), and email are confirmed across multiple pages. OSM lacked phone and address fields so those cannot be cross-confirmed.
concerns: OSM name 'Woodhaven Campground' vs website branding 'WoodHaven Campground' (minor capitalization difference)
Firewood noted as 'not currently available' on rates page
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active seasonal campground with tent sites, showers, and trail access near the Trans-Canada Highway. Contact page explicitly mentions biking as a guest activity. Good fit for touring cyclists in the Shuswap region.

wow_evidence: free showers are also available... biking as a guest activity
